- summarize the EM calorimeter findings, starting from ODD ECAL, then the nODD realistic Si-W version, the shortcomings of it, the eventual benefit of ALLIGRO, its updated service routing & performance comparison of all three - write a concise document (pdf) of max 10 pages including results and recommendations

I’ll trace the geometry and response results, then write a concise PDF comparing the three calorimeter stages, with recommendations and clear limits on what has been validated. I’m using the PDF skill to render and check the document.

The evidence spans different benchmark conditions, so I’ll label comparisons accordingly. ODD has earlier fixed-direction digitization studies; the recent matched 10k sample compares realistic Si–W with LAr. The routing prototype and 400 mm gap study are still separate drafts, so their status will stay explicit.
